title: Identity pairing coherence for base change
statement: For scheme morphisms f:X→Y and g:Y′→Y, with fibre-product projections f′ and gX, use the canonical derived base-change mate β [def-pc-derived-base-change-map], normalized pullback tensorators τ [lem-sc-mixed-hom-tensor-pullback-iso], and the counit-defined direct-image tensor pairing q [def-sc-mixed-direct-image-tensor-pairing]. For every A,B in D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], (β_A⊗β_B);q_f′(LgX*A,LgX*B);Rf′_*(τ_gX⁻¹) = τ_g⁻¹;Lg*(q_f(A,B));β_(A⊗B). This is the identity-pairing case; there is no arbitrary map a or object C.

source.place: Remark 08HY and Lemma 079U; duality.tex Tag 0AA8 final comparison diagrams

proof.text: Set a to the identity of A tensor B. Transpose the two sides under the f′ adjunction. Expand beta as the pullback-composition comparison followed by pulled-back f counit. Counit naturality and the f′ triangle identity reduce the two paths to the same tensor of f counits, up to compatibility of the pullback-composition comparison with the tensorators.

Prove that compatibility on K-flat representatives: the termwise pullback-composition comparison is the mate of the ordinary direct-image composition comparison, and the ordinary pullback tensor comparison sends pulled-back pure tensors to the tensor of their pulled-back sections. Both composition paths give those same sections. The normalization equations of the tensorators and composition comparisons transport this equation through their invertible derived counits. K-flat resolutions and naturality extend it to every A,B.

proof_origin.note: Second reading by J4: identity coherence remains open; naturality uses the existing private categorical proof, with no new assumptions.

theorem mixedTensorPairing_baseChange_identity
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (A B : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
    (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
        pullback.condition A ⊗ₘ
      schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
        pullback.condition B) ≫
      ((schemeHomPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g)).homEquiv _ _
        ((mixedHomTensorPullbackIso (pullback.snd f g)).hom.app
          ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj
              ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj A),
           (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj
              ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj B)) ≫
          ((schemeHomPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g)).counit.app
              ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj A) ⊗ₘ
           (schemeHomPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g)).counit.app
              ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj B)))) ≫
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).map
        ((mixedHomTensorPullbackIso (pullback.fst f g)).inv.app (A, B)) =
    (mixedHomTensorPullbackIso g).inv.app
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj A, (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj B) ≫
      (derivedPullback g).map
        (((schemeHomPullbackAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _
      ((mixedHomTensorPullbackIso f).hom.app
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj A, (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj B) ≫
        ((schemeHomPullbackAdjunction f).counit.app A ⊗ₘ
          (schemeHomPullbackAdjunction f).counit.app B)))) ≫
      schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
        pullback.condition (A ⊗ B)
